title: Wishful Aurosa

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered haute couture gown featuring an off-shoulder corseted bodice with a flared scalloped peplum, voluminous tiered tulle midi skirt, and sheer detached sleeves for an ethereal, asymmetrical volume.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate golden rose-vine crown with thorned arches and a translucent wire frame, adorned with small pearl accents and a trailing decorative ribbon at the back.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Cream silk bodice with a ruffled high neck collar and a central embellished medallion. Features intricately embroidered golden rose vines, a fitted corset structure with floral lace appliqués, and sheer organza off-shoulder sleeves with flared cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A voluminous tiered skirt of champagne tulle and gilded lace, featuring scalloped hems, intricate floral embroidery at the base, and a full petticoat structure. Styled with delicate floral garters and subtle golden strappy heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating golden rose petals, ethereal butterfly motifs, a sculpted golden rosebud accessory, and trailing golden vine ornaments that wrap around the ensemble.
